## Summary

## Category
- [ ] Mathematical correction (discussed in an issue first)

## Checks
- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] `MANIFEST.sha256` regenerated (`make hashes`) if files changed
- [ ] No scientific script was altered to make a check pass
- [ ] No claim added beyond the manuscript (no continuum-limit or mass-gap claims)
- [ ] `CLAIMS.md` / `README.md` updated if claims or scripts changed
